_comment: Street data built into the site at deploy time. Each region lists download URLs to try in order, and a bounding box [south, west, north, east] that the app treats as covered. BBBike has ~200 cities: https://download.bbbike.org/osm/bbbike/ . Geofabrik is a fallback: https://download.geofabrik.de/ (bigger files; only the bbox is kept).
